posts.title: Today I learned why sausage splits lengthwise
posts.description: As a chemical engineering student, I never expected to learn the physics behind why sausages usually split lengthwise. Sausages are actually very similar to pipes, and I learned about pipes. A sausage has a casing and its content/stuffing inside.
